title: Living on the levee and playing three nights a week for $2
summary: Hanging around the levee to avoid plantation work, playing three nights a week for a dollar and a half to two dollars.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: See with me a lot of us hang around that dick I tell you. See out there on them farms if you didn't work you couldn't stay there see. But when you get on by him out there on that levee couldn't nobody bother you. Nothing but the sheriff and if you just tell him you're just laying off or you're sick or something ask you where you're staying you tell him you live in Greentown or Morristown where he couldn't bother you. Couldn't bother you unless you live on this side on them planations see. Mm-hmm. All the way. So we didn't do nothing but hang on there and live and play music week like three nights a week and lived on it too.
You get much money for those three nights?
Yeah. Why do we get a dollar and a half? Some good people give us two dollars you know.
Oh yeah. That's good money though. Two dollars a night you could get. Yeah. You know a dollar, dick a dollar could buy you and have groceries all the week. Mm-hmm.
